title: Total time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be 12.5 s.

title: Mechanical energy calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be 188 J.

title: Friction heat calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must be 128 J.

title: Motor energy calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (4) must be 316 J.

title: Acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: Correctly calculates the object's acceleration using net force from friction and gravity components.

title: Two-phase motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: Identifies the two phases of motion: acceleration to belt speed and then uniform motion.

title: Relative displacement for heat
description: Important Criteria: Uses the relative displacement between object and belt to calculate frictional heat generation.

title: Energy accounting
description: Important Criteria: Correctly sums the object's final mechanical energy and frictional heat to find the motor's energy input.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses an incorrect sign for the net force, leading to a wrong acceleration direction or magnitude.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent SI units throughout all calculations.
